info.name: AuraCafe Integration - 32 workflow cases
info.description: 32 positive integration workflows mapped to the existing workbook. Run folders in listed dependency order on an isolated seeded database. Gateway (2 cases) and live OTP (1 case) require separate prerequisites; skipped requests do not mean Passed. No test execution results are claimed.
